## 3. Build assay matrices
```{r}

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(QFeatures)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# ---------------------
# Step 1: Filter evidence
# ---------------------
evidence <- evidence[(is.na(Reverse) | Reverse != "+") &
                     (is.na(`Potential contaminant`) | `Potential contaminant` != "+")]

tmt_cols <- grep("^Reporter intensity corrected", colnames(evidence), value = TRUE)

evidence <- evidence[
  rowSums(as.matrix(evidence[, tmt_cols, with = FALSE])) > 0
]

# ---------------------
# Step 2: Prepare sample annotation
# ---------------------
sample_annotation <- map %>%
  select(label, treatment, cell, `repeat`, sample, Experiment) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(`Experiment` != 4) %>% 
  mutate(
    TMT_channel = str_replace(label, "TMTpro-", "TMT"),
    TMT_channel = gsub(" ", "", TMT_channel),
    Experiment = paste0("Kit", Experiment)
  )

# ---------------------
# Step 3: Define TMTpro 16plex channel order
# ---------------------
channel_map <- c(
  "TMT126","TMT127N","TMT127C","TMT128N",
  "TMT128C","TMT129N","TMT129C","TMT130N",
  "TMT130C","TMT131N","TMT131C","TMT132N",
  "TMT132C","TMT133N","TMT133C","TMT134N"
)

# ---------------------
# Step 4: Build QFeatures object
# ---------------------
qf <- QFeatures()

experiments <- unique(evidence$Experiment)

for (exp in experiments) {
  
  message("Processing: ", exp)
  
  exp_data <- evidence[Experiment == exp]
  
  tmt_cols_exp <- grep("^Reporter intensity corrected",
                       colnames(exp_data),
                       value = TRUE)
  
  # Safety check
  stopifnot(length(tmt_cols_exp) == 16)
  
  # ---- Match annotation to channels ----
  used_channels <- sample_annotation %>%
    filter(Experiment == exp) %>%
    pull(TMT_channel)
  
  keep_idx <- match(used_channels, channel_map)
  keep_idx <- keep_idx[!is.na(keep_idx)]
  
  # ---- Subset intensity columns ----
  exp_subset <- exp_data[, tmt_cols_exp[keep_idx], with = FALSE]
  
  mat <- as.matrix(exp_subset)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(exp, "_", used_channels)
  
  stopifnot(ncol(mat) == length(used_channels))
  
  # ---------------------
  # rowData
  # ---------------------
  row_data_exp <- DataFrame(
    Sequence        = exp_data$Sequence,
    ModifiedSeq     = exp_data$`Modified sequence`,
    Proteins        = exp_data$Proteins,
    LeadingProtein  = exp_data$`Leading proteins`,
    GeneNames       = exp_data$`Gene names`,
    Charge          = exp_data$Charge,
    PEP             = exp_data$PEP,
    Score           = exp_data$Score,
    RawFile         = exp_data$`Raw file`,
    Experiment      = exp_data$Experiment,
    Reverse         = exp_data$Reverse,
    Contaminant     = exp_data$`Potential contaminant`
  )
  
  rownames(row_data_exp) <- exp_data$id
  
  # ---------------------
  # colData
  # ---------------------
  col_data_exp <- sample_annotation %>%
    filter(Experiment == exp & TMT_channel %in% used_channels) %>%
    mutate(colname = paste0(Experiment, "_", TMT_channel)) %>%
    arrange(match(TMT_channel, used_channels)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("colname") %>%
    DataFrame()
  
  stopifnot(ncol(mat) == nrow(col_data_exp))
  
  # ---------------------
  # Create SummarizedExperiment
  # ---------------------
  se_exp <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays  = list(intensity = mat),
    rowData = row_data_exp,
    colData = col_data_exp
  )
  
  qf[[exp]] <- se_exp
}
```

## 4. Normalize psm intensities

```{r}
library(matrixStats)

psm_sets <- names(qf)

for (psm_name in psm_sets) {
  
  message("Processing normalization: ", psm_name)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1) Extract raw assay
  # -------------------------
  raw_assay <- assay(qf[[psm_name]])
  raw_assay <- as.matrix(raw_assay)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2) Fraction of column total
  # -------------------------
  frac_assay <- sweep(raw_assay, 2,
                      colSums(raw_assay, na.rm = TRUE),
                      FUN = "/")
  
  scaled_assay <- frac_assay * 1e6
  
  frac_name <- paste0(psm_name, "_frac")
  
  qf[[frac_name]] <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays  = list(intensity = scaled_assay),
    rowData = rowData(qf[[psm_name]]),
    colData = colData(qf[[psm_name]])
  )
  
  qf <- addAssayLinkOneToOne(qf,
                             from = psm_name,
                             to   = frac_name)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 3) Add pseudocount
  # -------------------------
  frac_pc <- scaled_assay + 1e-6
  
  frac_pc_name <- paste0(psm_name, "_frac_pc")
  
  qf[[frac_pc_name]] <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays  = list(intensity = frac_pc),
    rowData = rowData(qf[[frac_name]]),
    colData = colData(qf[[frac_name]])
  )
  
  qf <- addAssayLinkOneToOne(qf,
                             from = frac_name,
                             to   = frac_pc_name)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 4) log2 transform
  # -------------------------
  log_name <- paste0(psm_name, "_log")
  
  qf <- logTransform(
    qf,
    i    = frac_pc_name,
    name = log_name
  )
  
  # -------------------------
  # 5) Quantile normalize
  # -------------------------
  norm_name <- paste0(psm_name, "_norm")
  
  qf <- normalize(
    qf,
    i      = log_name,
    name   = norm_name,
    method = "quantiles"
  )
}

```

## 5. Aggregation
```{r}
norm_sets <- grep("_norm$", names(qf), value = TRUE)

for (norm_name in norm_sets) {
  
  message("Aggregating: ", norm_name)
  
  # -------------------------
  # PSM → Peptide
  # -------------------------
  pep_name <- paste0(norm_name, "_peptide")
  
  qf <- aggregateFeatures(
    object = qf,
    i      = norm_name,
    fcol   = "Sequence",
    name   = pep_name,
    fun    = function(x)
      matrixStats::colMedians(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # -------------------------
  # Peptide → Protein
  # -------------------------
  prot_name <- paste0(norm_name, "_protein")
  
  qf <- aggregateFeatures(
    object = qf,
    i      = pep_name,
    fcol   = "Proteins",
    name   = prot_name,
    fun    = function(x)
      matrixStats::colMedians(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
    assay = assays,
```

## 11. Differential analysis

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo =FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DEP)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(S4Vectors)

protein_sets <- grep("_norm_protein$", names(qf), value = TRUE)

dep_results <- list()

for (prot_name in protein_sets) {
  
  message("Running DEP for: ", prot_name)
  
  protein_se <- qf[[prot_name]]
  
  # -------------------------
  # Build colData
  # -------------------------
  
  col_df <- as.data.frame(colData(protein_se))
  col_df$label     <- rownames(col_df)
  col_df$condition <- col_df$treatment
  col_df$replicate <- col_df$`repeat`
  
  # -------------------------
  # Build rowData (KEEP GeneNames)
  # -------------------------
  
  row_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(protein_se))
  
  # Make sure GeneNames column exists
  if (!"GeneNames" %in% colnames(row_df)) {
    stop("GeneNames column not found in rowData(protein_se)")
  }
  
  row_df$name  <- row_df$Proteins
  row_df$ID    <- paste0(row_df$Proteins, "_", seq_len(nrow(row_df)))
  row_df$gene  <- row_df$GeneNames   # 👈 IMPORTANT ADDITION
  
  assay_mat <- assay(protein_se)
  row_df <- cbind(row_df, assay_mat)
  
  columns <- (ncol(row_df) - ncol(assay_mat) + 1):ncol(row_df)
  
  # -------------------------
  # Make DEP object
  # -------------------------
  
  dep <- make_se(row_df, columns, col_df)
  
  # Impute
  dep <- DEP::impute(dep, fun = "MinProb", q = 0.01)
  
  # Remove Pool
  dep <- dep[, dep$condition != "Pool"]
  
  # Control
  dep <- test_diff(
    dep,
    type    = "control",
    control = "C"
  )
  
  dep <- add_rejections(
    dep,
    alpha = 0.05,
    lfc   = 0
  )
  
  # Store results (NOW includes gene column)
  res <- get_results(dep)

  
# -------------------------
# Normalize Kit4.3 vs Kit4.5 (ALL contrasts)
# -------------------------

if (prot_name == "Kit4_3_norm_protein") {

  kit45 <- dep_results[["Kit4_5_norm_protein"]]

  if (!is.null(kit45)) {

    kit45_fc <- kit45 %>%
      dplyr::select(
        name,
        A_vs_C_ratio_45  = A_vs_C_ratio,
        V_vs_C_ratio_45  = V_vs_C_ratio,
        VA_vs_C_ratio_45 = VA_vs_C_ratio
      )

    res <- res %>%
      dplyr::left_join(kit45_fc, by = "name") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        A_vs_C_ratio  = A_vs_C_ratio  - A_vs_C_ratio_45,
        V_vs_C_ratio  = V_vs_C_ratio  - V_vs_C_ratio_45,
        VA_vs_C_ratio = VA_vs_C_ratio - VA_vs_C_ratio_45
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        -A_vs_C_ratio_45,
        -V_vs_C_ratio_45,
        -VA_vs_C_ratio_45
      )
  }
}
# Extract gene names from DEP object
gene_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(dep))[, c("name", "gene")]

# Merge gene names back into results
res <- left_join(res, gene_df, by = "name")

dep_results[[prot_name]] <- res
}
```

```{r}
## Checking different thresholds
alpha_vals <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)
lfc_vals   <- c(0, 0.5, 1)

sig_summary <- list()

for (prot_name in protein_sets) {

  message("Running DEP for: ", prot_name)
  
  protein_se <- qf[[prot_name]]
  
  col_df <- as.data.frame(colData(protein_se))
  col_df$label     <- rownames(col_df)
  col_df$condition <- col_df$treatment
  col_df$replicate <- col_df$`repeat`
  
  row_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(protein_se))
  row_df$name  <- row_df$Proteins
  row_df$ID    <- paste0(row_df$Proteins, "_", seq_len(nrow(row_df)))
  row_df$gene  <- row_df$GeneNames
  
  assay_mat <- assay(protein_se)
  row_df <- cbind(row_df, assay_mat)
  columns <- (ncol(row_df) - ncol(assay_mat) + 1):ncol(row_df)
  
  dep <- make_se(row_df, columns, col_df)
  dep <- impute(dep, fun ="MinProb", q=0.01)
  dep <- dep[, dep$condition != "Pool"]
  
  dep <- test_diff(dep, type="control", control="C")
  
  # Test multiple alpha / lfc combinations
  for(a in alpha_vals){
    for(l in lfc_vals){
      
      dep_tmp <- add_rejections(dep, alpha=a, lfc=l)
      
      res <- get_results(dep_tmp)
      
      n_sig <- sum(res$significant, na.rm=TRUE)
      
      sig_summary[[length(sig_summary)+1]] <- data.frame(
        dataset = prot_name,
        alpha   = a,
        lfc     = l,
        significant_proteins = n_sig
      )
    }
  }
}

sig_summary <- bind_rows(sig_summary)
sig_summary
ggplot(sig_summary, aes(x=lfc, y=significant_proteins, color=factor(alpha))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset) +
  labs(
    color="alpha",
    x="log2FC threshold",
    y="Number of significant proteins"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
### Permutation test

```{r}
run_hybrid_permutation <- function(dep,
                                   control = "C",
                                   alpha = 0.05,
                                   lfc = 0,
                                   max_exact = 50000,
                                   n_mc = 10,
                                   seed = 1) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # -----------------------
  # ORIGINAL LABELS
  # -----------------------
  original_labels <- dep$condition
  n <- length(original_labels)

  # -----------------------
  # GENERATE UNIQUE PERMUTATIONS (EXACT MODE)
  # -----------------------
  perm_list <- gtools::permutations(
    n = n,
    r = n,
    v = original_labels
  )

  perm_list <- unique(perm_list)

  n_perm_exact <- nrow(perm_list)

  use_exact <- n_perm_exact <= max_exact

  # -----------------------
  # OBSERVED RESULT
  # -----------------------
  dep_obs <- test_diff(dep, type = "control", control = control)
  dep_obs <- add_rejections(dep_obs, alpha = alpha, lfc = lfc)

  obs_sig <- sum(get_results(dep_obs)$significant, na.rm = TRUE)

  # -----------------------
  # STORAGE
  # -----------------------
  perm_sig <- NULL

  # =========================================================
  # MODE 1: EXACT PERMUTATION
  # =========================================================
  if (use_exact) {

    message("Using EXACT permutation: ", n_perm_exact, " permutations")

    perm_sig <- numeric(n_perm_exact)

    for (i in seq_len(n_perm_exact)) {

      dep_perm <- dep
      dep_perm$condition <- perm_list[i, ]

      dep_perm <- test_diff(dep_perm, type = "control", control = control)
      dep_perm <- add_rejections(dep_perm, alpha = alpha, lfc = lfc)

      perm_sig[i] <- sum(get_results(dep_perm)$significant, na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    n_perm_used <- n_perm_exact
  }

  # =========================================================
  # MODE 2: MONTE CARLO PERMUTATION
  # =========================================================
  else {

    message("Using MONTE CARLO permutation: ", n_mc, " iterations")

    perm_sig <- numeric(n_mc)

    for (i in seq_len(n_mc)) {

      dep_perm <- dep

      # shuffle labels (correct null model)
      dep_perm$condition <- sample(original_labels)

      dep_perm <- test_diff(dep_perm, type = "control", control = control)
      dep_perm <- add_rejections(dep_perm, alpha = alpha, lfc = lfc)

      perm_sig[i] <- sum(get_results(dep_perm)$significant, na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    n_perm_used <- n_mc
  }

  # -----------------------
  # P-VALUE
  # -----------------------
  p_global <- (sum(perm_sig >= obs_sig) + 1) / (n_perm_used + 1)

  # -----------------------
  # OUTPUT
  # -----------------------
  list(
    observed_significant = obs_sig,
    permutation_distribution = perm_sig,
    global_p_value = p_global,
    n_permutations_used = n_perm_used,
    mode = ifelse(use_exact, "exact", "monte_carlo")
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    control = "C",

    seed = 123

}

summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(perm_results), function(nm) {

  res <- perm_results[[nm]]

  data.frame(
    dataset = nm,
    observed_sig = res$observed_significant,
    global_p = res$global_p_value
  )
}))
```

```{r}
      significant == "Significant" & !absent_in_long_term ~ "Sig_in_long_term",
```

```{r}
)

# Define treatment groups
allKit_mzML$treatment <- cut(
    allKit_mzML$file_index,
    breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36, 48),
    labels = c(
        "Short-term living cell CoPISA",
        "Long-term living cell CoPISA",
        "Short-term Cell lysate CoPISA",
        "Long-term expression proteomics"
    )
)

table(allKit_mzML$treatment)

# Create clean file names in mq
mq$file <- mq$`Raw file`
mq$file <- sub("\\.raw$", "", mq$file, ignore.case = TRUE)

# Build matching key in Spectra and mq
allKit_mzML$key <- paste(
    allKit_mzML$file,
    allKit_mzML$acquisitionNum,
    sep = "_"
)

mq$key <- paste(
    mq$file,
    mq$`Scan number`,
    sep = "_"
)

# Map and combine
spid <- match(allKit_mzML$key, mq$key)

allKit_mzML$sequence <- mq$Sequence[spid]
allKit_mzML$modified_sequence <- mq$`Modified sequence`[spid]
allKit_mzML$score <- mq$Score[spid]
allKit_mzML$pep <- mq$PEP[spid]
allKit_mzML$proteins <- mq$Proteins[spid]
```

# 20. Protein-centric workflow

```{r}
# =========================================================
# COMPLETE PUBLICATION-STYLE MS/MS PIPELINE
# Protein -> Best peptide -> Best spectra -> Fragmentation plot
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(PSMatch)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)

# =========================================================
# 1. FILTER IDENTIFIED MS2 SPECTRA
# =========================================================

id_spec <- allKit_mzML[
    !is.na(allKit_mzML$sequence) &
    allKit_mzML$msLevel == 2
]

# =========================================================
# 2. SELECT PROTEIN OF INTEREST
# =========================================================

protein_id <- "O60462"   # NRP2
Gene_name <- "NRP2"
prot_spec <- id_spec[
    grepl(protein_id, id_spec$proteins)
]

cat("Number of spectra from protein:", length(prot_spec), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 3. PEPTIDE SUMMARY + RANKING
# =========================================================

dt <- as.data.table(
    spectraData(prot_spec)
)

# peptide statistics per treatment
pep_summary <- dt[, .(
    n_spectra = .N,
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pep = mean(pep, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pep = median(pep, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(sequence, treatment)]

# peptide statistics globally
pep_summary_all <- dt[, .(
    n_spectra = .N,
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pep = median(pep, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_treatments = uniqueN(treatment)
), by = sequence]

# consistency metric
pep_summary_all[, consistency :=
    n_treatments / max(n_treatments)
]

# final ranking score
pep_summary_all[, final_score :=
    mean_score *
    consistency *
    log1p(n_spectra)
]

# rank peptides
pep_ranked <- pep_summary_all[
    order(-final_score)
]

top_peptide <- pep_ranked$sequence[1]

cat("Selected peptide:", top_peptide, "\n")

# =========================================================
# 4. SELECT BEST SPECTRA PER TREATMENT
# =========================================================

pep_spec <- id_spec[
    id_spec$sequence == top_peptide
]

spec_list <- split(
    pep_spec,
    pep_spec$treatment
)

# best spectrum index per treatment
best_idx <- tapply(
    seq_along(pep_spec$score),
    pep_spec$treatment,
    function(i) i[
        which.max(pep_spec$score[i])
    ]
)

best_spec <- pep_spec[
    unlist(best_idx)
]

# =========================================================
# 5. GENERATE THEORETICAL FRAGMENTS
# =========================================================

frags <- calculateFragments(top_peptide)

frag_df <- data.frame(frags) %>%
    filter(mz > 0)

frag_df$ion_type <- ifelse(
    grepl("^b", frag_df$ion),
    "b",
    "y"
)

# =========================================================
# 6. EXTRACT MS2 PEAKS
# =========================================================

best_list <- split(
    best_spec,
    best_spec$treatment
)

extract_ms2 <- function(spec, treatment_name) {

    data.frame(
        mz = as.numeric(mz(spec)[[1]]),
        intensity = as.numeric(intensity(spec)[[1]]),
        treatment = treatment_name
    )
}

ms2_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(best_list), function(tr) {

        extract_ms2(
            best_list[[tr]][1],
            tr
        )
    })
)

# =========================================================
# 7. SANITY CHECKS
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
    "mz" %in% names(ms2_df),
    "intensity" %in% names(ms2_df),
    is.numeric(ms2_df$mz),
    is.numeric(ms2_df$intensity)
)

# =========================================================
# 8. NORMALIZE INTENSITIES
# =========================================================

ms2_df <- ms2_df %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    mutate(
        intensity =
            intensity /
            max(intensity, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

# =========================================================
# 9. MATCH FRAGMENTS TO PEAKS
# =========================================================

match_fragments <- function(ms2, frag, tol = 0.5) {

    frag$peak_mz <- NA
    frag$peak_intensity <- NA
    frag$matched <- FALSE

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(frag))) {

        idx <- which(
            abs(ms2$mz - frag$mz[i]) <= tol
        )

        if(length(idx) > 0) {

            best <- idx[
                which.max(ms2$intensity[idx])
            ]

            frag$peak_mz[i] <- ms2$mz[best]
            frag$peak_intensity[i] <- ms2$intensity[best]
            frag$matched[i] <- TRUE
        }
    }

    frag
}

annotated_list <- lapply(
    split(ms2_df, ms2_df$treatment),
    function(df) {
        match_fragments(
            df,
            frag_df
        )
    }
)

frag_annot <- bind_rows(
    annotated_list,
    .id = "treatment"
)

# =========================================================
# 10. PLOT FUNCTION (POLISHED)
# =========================================================

plot_spectrum <- function(ms2, annot, panel_title) {

    ggplot(ms2, aes(x = mz, y = intensity)) +

        # raw spectrum
        geom_segment(
            aes(xend = mz, yend = 0),
            linewidth = 0.25,
            color = "black"
        ) +

        # b ions
        geom_segment(
            data = subset(annot, ion_type == "b" & matched),
            aes(x = peak_mz, xend = peak_mz, y = 0, yend = peak_intensity),
            color = "royalblue",
            linewidth = 0.5
        ) +

        # y ions
        geom_segment(
            data = subset(annot, ion_type == "y" & matched),
            aes(x = peak_mz, xend = peak_mz, y = 0, yend = peak_intensity),
            color = "forestgreen",
            linewidth = 0.5
        ) +

        # matched peaks
        geom_point(
            data = subset(annot, matched),
            aes(x = peak_mz, y = peak_intensity),
            color = "red",
            size = 1.6
        ) +

        # ion labels
        geom_text(
            data = subset(annot, matched),
            aes(x = peak_mz, y = peak_intensity, label = ion, color = ion_type),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            vjust = -0.7,
            show.legend = FALSE
        ) +

        scale_color_manual(values = c(b = "royalblue", y = "forestgreen")) +

        labs(
            title = NULL,
            x = "m/z",
            y = "Relative intensity"
        ) +

        ylim(0, 1.15) +

        # ✔ single clean metadata tag (corner label)
        annotate(
            "label",
            x = Inf,
            y = Inf,
            label = panel_title,
            hjust = 1.05,
            vjust = 1.2,
            size = 3.3,
            fontface = "bold",
            label.size = 0.25
        ) +

        theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

        theme(
            axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
        )
}

# =========================================================
# 11. BUILD SPECTRUM PANELS (POLISHED)
# =========================================================

panel_list <- lapply(
    unique(ms2_df$treatment),
    function(tr) {

        ms2_sub <- subset(ms2_df, treatment == tr)
        ann_sub <- subset(frag_annot, treatment == tr)

        # extract metadata safely
        score_val <- best_spec$score[best_spec$treatment == tr][1]
        charge <- best_spec$precursorCharge[best_spec$treatment == tr][1]

        panel_title <- paste0(
            tr,
            " | score: ", round(score_val, 2),
            " | z=", charge, "+"
        )

        plot_spectrum(ms2_sub, ann_sub, panel_title)
    }
)

main_panels <- wrap_plots(panel_list, ncol = 2)

# =========================================================
# 12. PEPTIDE COVERAGE MAP
# =========================================================

seq_df <- data.frame(
    aa = strsplit(top_peptide, "")[[1]],
    pos = seq_along(
        strsplit(top_peptide, "")[[1]]

            x = pos - 0.45,

    ) +

        aes(
            x = pos - 0.45,
            xend = pos + 0.45,

            yend = -0.1
        ),

        linewidth = 1.2
    ) +

    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1,
        y = 0.9,
        label = "b ions",
        color = "royalblue",

        "text",

        y = -0.9,
        label = "y ions",

    theme_void()

# =========================================================
# 13. METADATA PANEL
# =========================================================

precursor_mz <- round(
    precursorMz(best_spec)[1],
    4
)

charge <- best_spec$precursorCharge[1]

meta_text <- paste0(
    "Protein: ", protein_id, "\n",

    #"Peptide: ", top_peptide, "\n",

)

meta_plot <- ggplot() +

    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0,
        y = 1,
        label = meta_text,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 4
    ) +

    theme_void()

# =========================================================
# 14. FINAL LAYOUT
# =========================================================

final_plot <- plot_grid(
    #meta_plot,
    #top_map,

    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(

    )

# =========================================================
# 15. TITLE
# =========================================================

# title_plot <- ggdraw() +

# =========================================================
# 16. COMPLETE FIGURE
```
